shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null; find .agents -type f | head -50

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head; cat src/* index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts 2>/dev/null | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Avatar Button Card Text Flex Box FileInput 2>&1 | head -80; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | grep '"version"'
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Avatar Button Card Text Flex Box FileInput 2>&1 | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls | tr '\n' ' '; echo; cat TextInput/TextInput.d.ts TextInput/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120; ls FileInput Avatar Select Switch Checkbox

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Select/types.d.ts | grep -n -E "^\s+(value|defaultValue|onUpdate|options|label|filterable|width|size|placeholder|multiple|view|name|id|hasClear|popupWidth|renderControl|disabled|children):" | head -40; echo ---SWITCH; cat Switch/Switch.d.ts; echo ---CHECKBOX; cat Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -40; echo ---AVATAR; cat Avatar/Avatar.d.ts; ls Avatar/types; echo ---; ls controls controls/TextInput; grep -n -E "label|errorMessage|validationState|onUpdate|type\b|name|controlProps" controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts controls/types.d.ts | head -40; ls layout; grep -n "Props" Card/Card.d.ts | head

sed -n 1,60p Select/types.d.ts | head -5; grep -n -B1 -A3 -E "^\s+(value|options|label|filterable|width|size|placeholder|multiple|name|onUpdate|errorMessage|validationState|hasClear|popupWidth):" Select/types.d.ts | sed -n 1,10p >/dev/null; sed -n 1,200p Select/types.d.ts | grep -n -E "^\s*(value|defaultValue|onUpdate|options|label|filterable|width|size|placeholder|multiple|name|errorMessage|validationState|hasClear|disabled|view|pin|id)\??:"; cat ControlLabel/ControlLabel.d.ts | head -20; echo ---AV; cat Avatar/types/main.d.ts Avatar/types/common.d.ts | head -60; echo ---CTRL; sed -n 1,40p ../components/types.d.ts | grep -n -A25 "ControlProps"; echo ---BTN; grep -n -E "view|size|type|loading|disabled|onClick|extraProps" Button/Button.d.ts Button/definitions.d.ts | head -30; grep -n -E "variant|color" Text/Text.d.ts | head; sed -n 1,40p layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | grep -n -E "direction|gap|alignItems|justifyContent|wrap|space"

cat Avatar/AvatarImage/AvatarImage.d.ts | head -20; sed -n 1,30p Select/types.d.ts; sed -n 1,27p Card/Card.d.ts; grep -n -E "id\?|htmlFor|control" ControlLabel/ControlLabel.d.ts | head -3; sed -n 1,14p controls/types.d.ts | tail -7; grep -n -E "(color|variant)\??:" Text/Text.d.ts Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts Text/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head
